fullDesc: In 1934 the Chinese Communist army broke out of Nationalist encirclement and marched about 9,000 km across China for a year. Only a fraction of those who started survived, but Mao Zedong emerged as the leader.
realFacts: Some 86,000 began and about 8,000 to 10,000 arrived
They crossed rivers, mountains and swamps
Mao took leadership at the Zunyi conference
Communists won the civil war in 1949
